name: daita AI Agent
author: nicolasbonilla

sections.description:
One AI agent that sells and supports — on your own WordPress and WooCommerce store.

daita adds a conversational AI agent to your site that does what a great salesperson and a great support rep do, together, in one chat: it helps shoppers find the right product, recommends, builds the checkout, tracks orders and returns, captures leads and answers questions — 24/7, in your visitor’s language, by text, voice and image. EU data residency and GDPR-ready by design.

No code. Install, click once to create your agent, and it goes live on your site.

Not just a chatbot, and not just a search box — a unified commerce and support agent. The shopper can go “find me a warm jacket → where’s my order → return it” in a single conversation.

🛒 For WooCommerce stores

Connect your store in one click and the agent becomes your best salesperson:

  • Semantic product search — shoppers search by meaning, in any language. “something warm and waterproof for the mountains under €150” returns the right real products, not just keyword matches.
  • Search by photo — a shopper uploads an image and the agent finds visually similar products from your catalog.
  • Smart recommendations — personalised suggestions with a one-line reason each.
  • Secure checkout — the agent assembles a ready-to-pay checkout (single or multi-item); your shopper pays on your store. daita never touches card data.
  • Order status & returns — “where is my order?” and return requests, handled in chat (privacy-gated).
  • Stays fresh automatically — connecting registers real-time updates, so your catalog is always in sync. Catalog is read via the public WooCommerce Store API (keyless).

💬 For any WordPress site

  • Chat & real-time voice in one widget.
  • Multilingual — answers in your visitor’s language automatically.
  • Knowledge-grounded — answers from your own content, never invents.
  • Lead capture & booking built in.
  • Loads in the footer, deferred — no theme edits, no speed hit.
  • Your voice — set the agent’s title and its first message.

🇪🇺 Built EU-first, privacy-by-design

  • EU data residency — your data is stored and searched in the EU by default (database and semantic index hosted in the EU).
  • AI processing (for example the language model and voice) may use vetted subprocessors outside the EU under EU-approved safeguards (EU–US Data Privacy Framework, Standard Contractual Clauses).
  • GDPR-aligned by design — a Data Processing Agreement and a subprocessor list are available.
  • Your data is never used to train third-party models.

✨ Why daita

Search tools only search. Support tools only support. daita is one agent, one memory — discovery, selling, support and real actions on your live store, unified. EU data residency and GDPR-aligned throughout. See https://daita-ai.com

🚀 One-minute setup

  1. Install & activate the plugin.
  2. Click “Create my agent” in Settings → daita AI Agent (no Workspace ID to copy).
  3. Click “Connect WooCommerce” (optional) — the agent now searches your catalog.

That’s it — the agent is live on your storefront.

Pricing — clear and upfront: daita is a paid subscription service, from €149/month (excl. VAT), billed monthly and cancellable anytime, with no setup fee. This plugin is the GPL-licensed connector to that service; you can create and try your agent without a card, and going live starts a 14-day trial on a paid plan (secured by Stripe, not charged during the trial). Full pricing: https://daita-ai.com/pricing

External services

This plugin connects your site to daita, a third-party AI service, to provide the chat/voice/commerce assistant. This is required for the assistant to work.

  • It loads the widget script from https://daita-ai.com/embed.js.
  • When a visitor opens the chat, the widget sends their messages (and, only if you enable voice, audio) together with your Workspace ID to the daita backend (https://*.cloudfunctions.net) to generate replies. It also sends a one-time per-session “heartbeat” (your site’s hostname + Workspace ID) so you can confirm the agent is installed.
  • If you connect WooCommerce, your site’s product catalog is read (via the public WooCommerce Store API) and indexed by daita so the agent can search it; if you enable order lookups, a read-only WooCommerce API key is created so the agent can check order status. Product and order webhooks notify daita of changes.
  • No data is sent until a visitor interacts with the widget (the heartbeat aside).

Service provider: daita — https://daita-ai.com
Terms: https://daita-ai.com/terms · Privacy: https://daita-ai.com/privacy

By installing this plugin and creating a workspace you agree to daita’s terms and privacy policy. daita stores your data in the EU and is GDPR-aligned; some AI processing may use vetted subprocessors outside the EU under EU-approved safeguards (EU–US Data Privacy Framework, Standard Contractual Clauses). A subprocessor list and Data Processing Agreement are available.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “daita AI Agent”, and click Install then Activate. (Or upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/.)
  2. Go to Settings → daita AI Agent.
  3. Click “Create my agent” (enter your store name + email). Your agent goes live instantly. (Already have a Workspace ID? Paste it instead.)
  4. Optional: in the WooCommerce section, click “Connect WooCommerce” to enable product search, recommendations and checkout.
sections.faq:
Do I need to write any code?

No. Click “Create my agent” in Settings → daita AI Agent and the widget loads on every front-end page automatically.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Click “Connect WooCommerce” and the agent searches your catalog semantically (any language), recommends products, builds secure checkout links, and can check order status. It auto-detects your site and keeps the catalog in sync with real-time updates.

Do I need a WooCommerce API key?

No for product search — the catalog is read via the public WooCommerce Store API (keyless). Only if you enable order-status lookups does the plugin create a read-only API key for you, automatically.

How much does it cost?

daita is a paid subscription from €149/month (excl. VAT), billed monthly, cancel anytime, no setup fee. This plugin is the GPL-licensed connector and adds no charge of its own. You can create and try your agent without a card; going live starts a 14-day trial on a paid plan (secured by Stripe, not charged during the trial). Full pricing: https://daita-ai.com/pricing

Where is my data processed?

Data at rest is stored in the EU by default (database and semantic search in the EU). Some AI processing — for example the language model and voice transcription — may run via vetted subprocessors outside the EU under EU-approved safeguards (EU–US Data Privacy Framework, Standard Contractual Clauses). Your data is never used to train third-party models. See https://daita-ai.com/trust and https://daita-ai.com/privacy

Is it GDPR compliant?

daita stores your data in the EU and is GDPR-aligned by design. A Data Processing Agreement and a subprocessor list are available — see https://daita-ai.com/trust

Will it slow down my site?

No. The widget script is enqueued in the footer and deferred, so it loads after your page content.

Is voice included?

The widget supports text chat out of the box. Real-time voice is optional and only activates if you enable it for your workspace.

In which languages does the agent reply?

Your agent answers in your visitor’s language automatically (multilingual by default).

How do I temporarily hide the assistant?

Go to Settings → daita AI Agent and uncheck “Show on site”, then save. No need to deactivate the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Tested against WordPress 7.0 (activation, settings save round-trip and front-end output verified on 7.0.1, PHP 8.3; no notices).
  • Removed the “Accent color” setting. The widget renders in daita’s own identity, and the value was never read — the field promised a change it could not make. Your stored value is left untouched.
  • Refreshed the WordPress.org listing artwork (banner, icon, screenshots) to the current product.

1.1.0

  • New: WooCommerce integration. Connect your store so the agent searches your catalog semantically (any language), recommends products, builds secure checkout links (single or multi-item), and (optionally) checks order status. One click auto-detects your site, can create a read-only API key for order lookups, and registers real-time webhooks so the catalog stays fresh. Catalog read via the public Store API (keyless).
  • New: one-click onboarding. Create your daita agent right from the plugin — no Workspace ID to copy/paste. After creating your workspace, WooCommerce connect is one click too.
  • EU data residency throughout (GDPR-aligned).

1.0.3

  • Pricing disclosure updated for the new self-service flow (14-day free trial, then monthly; no setup fee).

1.0.2

  • Clearer, upfront pricing disclosure (free plugin + free trial; paid plans to go live), per WordPress.org guidelines.

1.0.1

  • Remove load_plugin_textdomain() (not needed for WordPress.org-hosted plugins since WP 4.6).
  • Documentation and readme improvements.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
